report.summary: All 4 UI tests timed out at 5000ms. The cause is a random delay in the app: `list_books` sleeps for a random 0–8 seconds, and every `/books` page load goes through it. Remove or bound that sleep first. The tests are flaky, not broken, so they should pass on a rerun when the delay happens to be short.

causes.title: Random 0-8s delay in list_books makes /books loads exceed the 5s Playwright timeout
causes.explanation: `list_books` in app/main.py calls `time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))`. The delay is random, so roughly 37% of `/books` renders take longer than 5s. The `/books` page, API listing and post-login or post-register redirect all go through it. Tests that navigate to `/books` hit `Page.goto` timeouts. The register test's click waits for the navigation to `/books` after the redirect, so it times out too. The same code would pass on a rerun when the delay is short, so the outcome depends on chance rather than on a wrong behaviour. I did not open the test files or the other three tracebacks, so grouping them under this cause is an inference from the shared error type and the code path.
evidence: app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]) is called from render_books, which serves /books
Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done - waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (register submit redirects to /books)
Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded in the three other tests
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from `list_books`, or put it behind a debug flag that is off in tests. If the latency has to stay, raise the Playwright navigation timeout above 8s and do not rely on 5s. Rerun to confirm.
